info.title: Foresignal API
info.summary: Headless intelligence broker: ingest, version and re-serve public telemetry.
info.description: All configuration is done through this API. The MCP server (streamable HTTP) is at `/mcp` and is not described here; it exposes the same data as tools. Reads of data are open on the local network; all writes and settings reads require the admin bearer token printed on first start. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC. `/v1` is additive-only once released.

embed.description: Embed this source's records for semantic search (default true when the source declares embedFields)

credentialsSet.description: True if credentials are stored (values never returned)

SourceSettingsUpdate.description: Partial update; omitted fields unchanged. retention=null reverts to global default.

mode.description: match: fire on every matching version. enter: fire when a record's version satisfies the rule and its previous version did not (or it is new). exit: fire when the previous version satisfied the rule and this version does not. Edge modes evaluate geofence and conditions together.

enrich.description: Add an LLM context summary to each alert (requires a chat provider)

TriggerRuleInput.description: All conditions are ANDed. geofence must be Polygon or MultiPolygon. At least one of source, kind, conditions, geofence is required.

summary.description: LLM context summary when the rule has enrich=true

openReads.description: When false, data GETs require a read token

publicBaseUrl.description: Base URL used in notification links

config.description: Non-secret settings per the type's configFields

secrets.description: Write-only secret settings per the type's secretFields

degraded.description: True when semantic was requested but text was used

bearerToken.description: Scoped API token (read < agent < admin). The bootstrap admin token is printed once on first start. Required scope per operation is in `x-foresignal-scope`.

ingestKey.description: Per-source ingest key returned once when a custom source is created
